children.title: Direct-edit guard
children.intent: WHEN an agent writes .shape JSON directly THE SYSTEM SHALL deny and point at the CLI
children.gap: manually verified only; no automated test invokes the hook script

children.title: Per-prompt context injection
children.intent: WHEN a prompt is submitted THE SYSTEM SHALL inject the current tree, gated on change or staleness
children.gap: manually verified only; gating, budget use, and prime-vs-short selection untested

children.title: Omission nudge
children.intent: WHEN edited files are referenced by no node THE SYSTEM SHALL nudge once per file per session
children.gap: no automated test; ledger read-modify-write can lose entries under parallel PostToolUse hooks (should be append-only)

children.title: Delegation reminder
children.intent: WHEN a subagent is spawned THE SYSTEM SHALL remind the lead to carry relevant nodes into the brief
children.gap: manually verified only; no automated test

children.title: Workflow skills
children.intent: WHEN the shape or survey skill activates THE SYSTEM SHALL teach the maintenance loop, evidence bar, and report-before-write survey
